name: Marketing Consultant
seoTitle: Business Insurance Cost for Marketing Consultants
seoDescription: Calculate estimated business insurance costs for marketing consultant businesses including general liability and professional E&O coverage.

industryContext.contextNote: Marketing consultants advise on campaigns and strategy without physical work product, so their exposure centers on advertising claims and campaign performance disputes.

riskFactors.title: Misleading Advertising Claims
riskFactors.description: Campaign content that overstates a client's product or service claims can expose both the consultant and client to regulatory or third-party claims.

riskFactors.title: Campaign Performance Disputes
riskFactors.description: Clients who don't see expected results from a marketing strategy may allege the consultant's advice was negligent.

riskFactors.title: Intellectual Property Missteps
riskFactors.description: Using third-party images, music, or brand elements without proper licensing in campaign materials can trigger infringement claims.

faqs.question: Why do marketing consultants need Professional Liability insurance?
faqs.answer: It covers claims that marketing advice or campaign strategy was negligent or failed to deliver agreed results, which General Liability doesn't address.

faqs.question: What is the average cost of business insurance for a marketing consultant?
faqs.answer: A marketing consultant in the $0-50k revenue tier pays an estimated $260 per year for baseline General Liability coverage.

faqs.question: Does marketing consultant insurance cover advertising claim disputes?
faqs.answer: Professional Liability can cover claims tied to advisory mistakes, but regulatory advertising violations may require additional review with a carrier depending on the campaign type.

faqs.question: Is General Liability enough for a marketing consultant?
faqs.answer: Most marketing consultants pair General Liability with Professional Liability (E&O), since the bulk of their real exposure comes from campaign advice, not physical premises risk.

blogContent.whyThisRiskFactor: Marketing consultants carry a 0.95 actuarial risk factor, reflecting low physical hazard offset by advisory and intellectual-property exposure.
blogContent.howCalculated: Premiums scale with revenue tier, team size, and Professional Liability (E&O) endorsements.
blogContent.comparisonNote: Marketing consulting premiums are similar to HR consulting and social media management, reflecting comparable low-physical, advice-driven risk profiles.
